dataList.content:
<So that thing behind him is...>
<在那后面的是……>
dataList.place:
Mirror Dungeon of the Fathoms
心象镜像迷宫

dataList.content:
Indeed, that is the Monolith. The artifact must have entered his fathoms of ego the moment it imbued Bamboo-hatted Kim with strength.
是独石。当它赋予金笠力量时就藏进他的心象中了。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
This manor must be... where the mentor's last protectee resided before we departed S Corp.
这座宅邸……记得是离开S公司之前，头领最后负责护卫的目标的住宅。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Ah... such massacre...
啊啊……这等惨状……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Mentor, was this carnage the memory that has haunted your dreams and your waking hours for so long...?
难道……至今为止这幅惨状一直在头领脑中挥之不去吗……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Yet... the deaths of our dear fellows...
然而……即便如此……友人们的枉死……

Tears begin to well in Aeng-du's eyes.
樱桃的眼中噙着泪水。

Again, something murmurs in my head.
脑海中又传来了低语。

Is this... Bamboo-hatted Kim's past?
这是……金笠的过去吗。

A somber voice, drenched with woe, echoes in my head.
沉闷而阴郁的声音似乎直接在我脑海中响起。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
... For a fleeting moment, I once had this thing people call 'honor'.
曾几何时，我也有过荣誉。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
Vile men, whose hearts are consumed by evil, oft approach virtuous officials to seek harm.
心存邪念的恶人时常接近清廉的官吏。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
And I considered it an honorable deed to be a protector of the virtuous, to hew those that sought harm against them.
身为护卫武士，以自己的剑击退那些恶人，于我而言曾是荣誉。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
Yet, to be virtuous in a world of the vicious was to be prey to this merciless world.
……然而，清正廉洁之人往往只会被世间蚕食。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
And before such overwhelming might of the vicious, the irrevocably corrupt officials... my strength was inconsequential.
想要抵抗早已腐烂入骨的贪官污吏，我的力量太过微弱。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
I had little choice but to leave S Corp. cradling my broken spirit alongside my fellows.
最终只能怀抱破碎不堪的心，与同伴们一同离开S公司。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
I have left my scarred honor behind at the land of my failure.
未能履行职责，荣誉被我遗弃在了那里。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
We became vagabonds. Lost, wandering, and weary; aimless drifters without a place to call their home.
失去栖身之所，四处奔波而身心俱疲的同伴们与我。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
Even their faith in my decision to leave began to crumble piece by piece. So did my faith in myself.
他们追随我离去的那份信赖随时间流逝，甚至我自己也逐渐丧失对自身的信任。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
I began to... fall apart.
我……逐渐消逝。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
I have already failed once. What's there to say that I am not failing my dear fellows once again...?
未能履行职责的我，又怎能领导他们。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
The least I could do is to help them lead a stable life...
但至少要让他们能安稳生活……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
Yet that 'invitation' I received... only led them to their demise.
可，怀揣如此期待得到的“邀请函”，却将所有人送向灭亡。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
In the end... I failed my mission. I failed my honor. I failed my dear fellows.
最终，使命未竟、名誉不复、友人离散……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage?
剑契组？
dataList.content:
Again, I am returned to the land of my failure...
我又与那时一样……

The voice continued to murmur. But... it had devolved into nothing but a low growl, a quiet and incoherent rumbling.
他还在说着什么……但我只能听到如同咆哮般的低语。

I can't help but feel a bit of sympathy at his suffocatingly painful past...
他罗列出令人窒息的痛苦过去，不禁让我心生同情……

... but that's exactly why we have to face him. To free him from this Distortion.
正因如此才要尽早直面他，将他从扭曲中解放出来。

<Guys. We're putting an end to this. Right here, right now.>
<各位，就在这里和他做个了断吧。>

Yes. It appears that we have no choice.
是，我们似乎别无选择。

Aeng-du's grown far too agitated to function properly in this battle.
情绪过于激动的樱桃大概无法顺利参与战斗。

It's... all up to us now.
需要由我们……来结束这一切。
